knobs.name: size
knobs.what: label size px (11 is the page floor)

knobs.name: title_size
knobs.what: chart name and column title size px

knobs.name: value_size
knobs.what: before and after value size px

knobs.name: width
knobs.what: picture width in px

knobs.name: gutter
knobs.what: space between the two columns in px

knobs.name: accent
knobs.what: the column whose rule and after-values take the accent
